claims: `--refused-inventory-repo` fallback is dead — `scripts/sentry/autofix/sentry-autofix-run-record.mjs:67` uses a default parameter (`repo = REFUSED_INVENTORY_DEFAULT_REPO`), which only fires on `undefined`, but `readFlag` (`sentry-autofix-finalize.mjs:711-716`) returns `null` when a flag is absent, so links render `github.com/null`
No test covers `--refused-inventory-repo` through the CLI at all — the new finalize test (`sentry-autofix-finalize.test.mjs:1801`) only exercises the `unknown` branch, which never builds a URL

Label strings are hardcoded, bypassing the queue contract — `scripts/sentry/autofix/sentry-autofix-refused-inventory.mjs:26` inlines `label:sentry-triage label:sentry:fix-refused` as literals, while `QUEUE_LABEL` and `FIX_REFUSED_LABEL` are the repo's single source (`scripts/sentry/triage/sentry-triage-queue-contract.mjs:85,191`)

If either label string drifts, the query matches nothing and the fail-closed validation passes — `total_count: 0` with `items: []` satisfies `validIssueList(0, 0)`, so `parseRefusedStubInventory` returns `{state: "known", count: 0}` and the tracker reports `Refused stubs (all states): 0` forever — a miss renders as `0`, not `unknown`

The colon-bearing label is unquoted at `sentry-autofix-refused-inventory.mjs:26` (`label:sentry:fix-refused`), diverging from the repo's convention where the selector's query builder quotes it (`sentry-autofix-queue-io.mjs:278` renders `-label:"${FIX_REFUSED_LABEL}"`); if GitHub's parser doesn't take the full `sentry:fix-refused` as the qualifier value, you get a wrong count reported as `known`
The test at `sentry-autofix-run-record.test.mjs:116` pins the unquoted string, so it would need updating too

`parseRefusedStubInventoryResult` runs twice per render — once at `sentry-autofix-finalize.mjs:824`, then again inside `renderRefusedStubInventory` (`sentry-autofix-run-record.mjs:70`); the finalize-side call is just dead work
